what_changed:
Custom HTTP headers: send proxy auth headers with Immich requests.
• Turn on Enable custom HTTP headers under Settings -> Immich Server, then add any number of rows
• Applied to API calls, Local URL probing, thumbnails, uploads/downloads, and video playback, but never to CDN/S3 redirects

Packaging: CMake options for distro builds (PR #14) — disable in-app updater, rename the executable, and show build info like "(AUR)".

Docs: Arch Linux AUR package mentioned in the README (PR #15).

Library performance on large libraries (PR #13): batch offline-cache writes, only show tiles near the viewport, fix new-photo checks for Live Photos / after streamed refresh, and retry thumbnails that 404 right after upload.

Viewer: step through photos and videos in Library and Explore (PR #7).
• On-screen controls or arrow keys; videos play in the shared viewer
• Explore gets Copy/Download/Share/Trash/Delete; deleted items leave Explore lists

Library & Explore: zoomable thumbnail grids and a collapsible sidebar (PR #8).
• Zoom with +/- or Ctrl+scroll; tile size is remembered
• Sidebar collapses on demand and auto-collapses on narrow windows
• Larger zoom loads sharper tile images

Viewer info panel (PR #9).
• Toggle with Info, I, or the thumbnail context menu
• Date, camera, location, people, albums, tags; click to jump into Library/Explore

mTLS client certificates (PR #11, closes #10).
• PKCS#12 or PEM cert+key and optional CA in Settings -> Immich Server
• Hidden until Enable client certificate is checked; page scrolls when the form is tall
• Applies to remote-origin traffic only (not Local URL / CDN hops)

Library loads months progressively (fixes #12).
• Up to 4 months in parallel; newest months appear immediately
• Scroll space for the rest is reserved from timeline bucket counts

Also:
• Quieter Library toolbar (icon-only Upload/Refresh/Years, compact zoom)
• Rolling beta builds on every push to main (GitHub beta release + Snap beta/edge)
• About credits gardar as a major contributor
